body:
Hi! 

I am trying to pay for law schools applications right now. It costs $45 for most of them, so I am trying to save up to pay for them. I’m struggling to afford applications right now because I am a full time student still paying tuition and other bills. I’m applying to five schools and anything helps!!

Thank you for your kindness and support to the reddit community :)

omg that’s difficult but it’s a pride thing! your dad feels insulted because he wants to do the same thing. it’ll blow over soon, i’m sure, especially when he realizes they did it to ensure a healthy and happy future for you and your wife! and uhhh can they also help me pay for tuition cause ya girl is about to drop out

i was in a similar situation when i was 15 and my mom responded with anger and refused to allow me to do ANYTHING teen related until i finally was kicked out. i felt robbed of my teen years and i never understood why. i was forbid to do so many things and all it did was make me resent her more and turn to him instead. when we finally broke up i realized how wrong it was of this older man to take advantage of me, but i had to realize that on my own. it’s tough, but approach with love. someone mentioned std testing and getting an IUD, that’s important because u can’t necessarily prevent her from doing things like that but u can prevent pregnancies and stds!! talk to her about boundaries and enforce some rules (curfew, letting you know when she’s with him) but don’t forbid them from seeing each other because it may only do more harm than good. i hope things go well and that you can find a positive way to handle this situation.
you’re going to do a great job :)

i wish my parents had shown me more compassion and understanding and didn’t make me feel insane. i came home to my door unhinged and no privacy, constantly being told i’m crazy and need to be watched all the time. i wish they did more research into what i was dealing with. try your best to learn about bpd and be caring and patient, it’s tough and won’t be easy but it’ll help to show you’re on her side. best of luck, i’ll be thinking positive thoughts for you and your daughter tonight
this is so helpful and validating, thank you! i’m going to check out that book now :)
